An installation runs Spinbox `v20261026.02`, the newest release spin-terraform-aws's `images.json` has images of. It is made of:

| Part | Release | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| spin: the control plane, the runner, the proxy and the CLI | `v20261026.02` | spin-terraform-aws's `images.json` |
| spin-machine: QEMU, the guest kernel, the firmware and the base image a workspace boots, as one artefact | [`v20261023.01`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin-machine/releases/tag/v20261023.01) | spin's `versions.yaml` at `v20261026.02` |
| The OpenTofu module, spin-terraform-aws | [`v20261027.01`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin-terraform-aws/releases/tag/v20261027.01) | its newest release tag |

The versions of QEMU and the guest kernel in spin-machine `v20261023.01` are its own [`versions.yaml`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin-machine/blob/v20261023.01/versions.yaml) at that tag. The host's kernel is the Spin OS image's: none of the sources this site is generated from records its version.

## Spin OS images

Each machine boots the image of its role, in a region that has all three ([Spin OS images](/reference/terraform/images/)):

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-0774cba716732d76f` | `ami-0d23fd135c2b1569a` | `ami-04dfd5df7d3bbaf5a` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-0c0458b4218567425` | `ami-08808879d20e484cc` | `ami-0a2410b4fdd3f37e2` |
